newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-ANZ says restructuring Oman business.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-ANZ says restructuring Oman business.

text.p: Australia and New Zealand Banking Group Ltd said on Tuesday that it was restructuring its operations in the Gulf state of Oman.
It said the two branches of ANZ Grindlays Bank in Oman would be sold to a new, publicly-listed Omani bank in which ANZ would have a minority shareholding.

"In addition to maintaining an equity investment, ANZ plans, through its international network, to cooperate with the new bank, and will for the time being be providing technical and management support," ANZ executive director Alister Maitland said in a statement.

ANZ said it had strong private and investment banking capabilities and long experience in working in the region in infrastructure finance. "We intend to concentrate on these areas with retail banking requirements being handled by the new bank -- the Oman Savings and Finance Bank," Maitland said.
